parsed_response.short_rationale: This observational study relating seed rain to habitat, perch, and plant density is subject to confounding (e.g., bird habitat use, seed predation by granivores varying among habitats, natural perch availability differing between habitats). The authors acknowledge but did not control for these confounders (e.g., differential seed predation and natural perch availability), and no justifiable reason or method (such as an instrumental variable) is provided to make omission unlikely to affect the estimates.

This observational study comparing seed rain across habitats and perch conditions is susceptible to confounding (e.g., bird habitat use, natural perch availability, seed predation varying by habitat, granivore abundance). The authors acknowledge but did not control for these factors (natural perches, differential seed predation in maple-beech forests), and no formal confounder adjustment was performed, leaving high risk of confounding bias.
